body:
Claim: the boot-splash surface.

Main will open the window immediately on a tiny static splash page (app/splash.html, no bundle, no React),
streaming boot stages over IPC: sidecar spawning -> handshake -> health -> ready. Failures (bad handshake,
unhealthy sidecar, sidecar exit) render in the splash with a restart affordance instead of a dark frame or
a modal. On ready, main navigates to the app (Vite in dev, dist bundle in prod) and the splash unmounts.

Scope: app/main/index.ts, app/preload/index.ts, app/splash.html, app/renderer/boot.{ts,css}.
Safe: no peer holds a live claim on these paths (Nadia's ui-rebuild release closed at 12:43Z; her current
work is driving runs, not editing). Touches main/preload she shipped, but only additively around window
creation. Verification: npm run typecheck, npm run test, npm run build, then a real `npx electron .` launch.
